div.p: This example contains custom embedded extensions that define the appearance of a form that are used to drive the creation of the rendering Liquid. These include extensions that override the text, manage whitespace, change color and formatting, grouping, etc. None of these extensions are 'standard'. They are included here only as examples of the sort of additional metadata an author could potentially include in their Questionnaire to help drive the rendering process.

To find the extensions, look at one of the computable views (XML, JSON, or TTL) and search for note-info, which is part of the name of the example extensions used on groups, questions, display items, and answer options within this example.
